device_entry.name: GSV-3USB传感器测量放大器
tags: 电压监测与传感器信号采集
载荷与应变片信号采集
device_entry.description: 这是一种通过 USB 连接的传感器测量放大器/信号调理设备，常用于连接应变片式力传感器、称重传感器等，将传感器输出转换为可读取的数字测量值。在实验室中可用于力、重量或相关模拟信号的采集，并支持清零、偏置、量程极性与连续数据传输等操作。
device_entry.description_en: This is a USB-connected sensor measurement amplifier and signal-conditioning unit, typically used with strain-gauge force sensors, load cells, and similar transducers. It converts sensor output into readable digital measurements for laboratory force, weight, or related analog-signal acquisition, and supports zeroing, offset adjustment, polarity/range selection, and continuous data transmission.
